description: ACI_Archi_stradali is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by apps.romagnafaentina.it. Mapping of the road network of the Municipality of Faenza. Description fields: ‘institution’ means: Code belfiore of the Municipality, "Codicevia": Unique street identifier, ‘Name’: Name of the street, "Data Beginning": date added to the map. Coverage: IT. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. The listing shows 2025-07-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://w3id.org/italia/controlled-vocabulary/licences/A21_CCBY40). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
